plotSections.title: Investigating the Lich
bullets: Sylan and Walker conclude that the party has learned more about the lich but is still no closer to locating him or identifying his phylactery.

The lich's phylactery is believed to be a mundane object that he keeps on his person. The party has repeatedly noticed him carrying or keeping chess pieces or war-game pieces nearby, raising the possibility that a chess set or one of its pieces could be the phylactery.

The party discusses the nature of a phylactery and confirms from their lore that it is a vessel containing the lich's soul, though their available lore does not explain exactly how the lich returns after bodily destruction.

plotSections.title: Walker's Scouting Mission to The Reach
bullets: Walker wants to travel to The Reach to recharge his gems. The party agrees this is worthwhile as long as the trip remains a scouting mission rather than an attempt to fight the lich.

Walker intends to travel with Elrus and Araden, keeping the group small so they can move quickly. Walker specifically wants to preserve Elrus and Araden as hidden assets because the lich has learned weaknesses from previous encounters.
Sylan stresses that Walker should retreat immediately if he encounters danger. The rest of the party will remain available to return in force if necessary.

Walker will take the party's sending stone from the ship and use it to keep the others informed. The stone permits a message of up to 25 words once per day, though the party is uncertain how its recharge interacts with The Reach's altered flow of time.
The party plans to travel to Langdale while Walker conducts his mission, intending to speak with Carlkin and possibly Benji before meeting Walker again.

plotSections.title: Travel and Time Between Realms
bullets: The party establishes that traveling to Langdale from their current location takes about a week.

Time passes differently in The Reach: the party discusses an approximate ratio of one day in their current realm to seven days in The Reach. This means Walker could potentially spend roughly a month in The Reach while only about a week passes for the rest of the party.

The party recalls that their previous use of the arch brought them out near the Whispering Abyss. From there, the training grounds are approximately five days of flight away, near the Lost Isles and a group of mountains between three islands.
